objective: Maximize legitimate wedding-planning discoverability, verified external citations/references, and meaningful LLM/search surfacing toward the portfolio 100K objective.
truth_boundary: 100K target is not guaranteed and is not a page quota.
required_strategies: citation magnets: checklists, decision matrices, calculators, templates, planning frameworks and reference guides
machine-readable semantic pages and structured data
freshness and source checks where facts are local or time-sensitive
accepted guide freeze with exact thaw-repair-refreeze
runtime_boundary: Freeze applies to canonical authority guide content only. User planner state, checkout, admin, authentication, commerce and runtime application behavior remain dynamic.
storage_policy: compressed sharded planning corpus; repository byte size is not a fanout KPI
